dataList.content: The battle continues in a standstill.
We wear down the Chaplain after a grueling battle, and he rebuilds himself with the flick of his fingers.
Against this hopeless situation, we lean on the memories of the past, and destroy what is once again rebuilt.
Meursault never stops opening the door.
And every time he opens the door, he hears his mother's cry. He is endlessly tormented by guilt. But he keeps turning the handle.
Together, we repeat these... meaningless, superfluous actions.
The Sinners do not say a word as the cycle returns to the starting point over and over again.
Time flows helplessly. Ages pass us by.
And without knowing what this all means, if this flow will result in our success, or abject failure...
